settings.name: ElliottWaveCountLifecycle
notes: Revision 1, 2026-09-25, from Guillaume's 17 comments on the proposal page (G1-G17). Draft 0 was 2026-09-24. Episode 140 strategic entry, session c9ee574b-0165-44e9-8974-4e83a977ae55.

One point of view: one instrument x timeframe. The degree follows the timeframe (G13: M1 Cycle, W1 Primary, D1 Intermediate, H4 Minor, H1 Minute, m15 Minuette, m5 Subminuette, after Frost and Prechter). A higher degree runs its own instance; the two meet through WaveCount.parent_artifact_id.

The Reading composite is caishen spec 87's reading machine. What a person places on the chart is a wave label at the end point of the wave it names (spec 80 WavePoint + ElliottWaveLabel), stored with tool wave_label. The word pivot is not used (G1, G8; the BOSf drift review removed it on 2026-09-03 for the same reason).

The count's invalidation level is computed from Elliott's rules over the labels, never typed (G14): wave 2 never goes beyond the start of wave 1, wave 3 is never the shortest of 1, 3 and 5, wave 4 never enters wave 1's price territory. The mandate's own invalidation is chosen when Guillaume authorizes, and defaults to the count's level.
Publishing a count and asking for a blueprint are two acts. The second is optional (G6).

The strategy is created when the mandate sees a breakout point, not when a signal fires (G12). The entry signal belongs to the strategy's own machine. strategy_type fdb_breakout is BOS in the UI; bosf_breakout is BOSf, BOS with a fractal count, not implemented yet. Both use the FDB principle (G5, G11).

Owners: Reading = jgt-charting; Published and BlueprintRequested = jgt-analysis-intelligence :8085; Mandate = jgt-blueprint-api :8086, a PROTOTYPE that never delivered anything working (Guillaume, 2026-09-24; 0 mandates that day); StrategicEntry = jgt-strategy-api :8083, whose trading campaigns record wins and losses.

TRADABLE_LABELS = W1 W2 W3 W5 A C E, judged at the degree being traded (caishen spec 85 rule 2). A wave A or E inside a higher-degree W4 is tradable at its own degree; the parent W4 is shown as context (G2, decision D7).

states.name: Reading
states.description: Owner: jgt-charting, tool wave_label. Guillaume labels waves on the chart; each label is a chart_drawings row at the end point of the wave it names. Nothing here is evidence yet.

states.name: Reading_Unset
states.description: No act of analysis on this point of view (spec 80: Unset = -100).

states.name: Reading_Identified
states.description: A primary count is held. The invalidation level is recomputed from Elliott's rules on every label.

states.name: Reading_Contested
states.description: Primary and alternate are both held. The computed level is the price that decides between them (spec 87).

states.name: Reading_Unclear
states.description: Guillaume looked and could not name it (X records Unknown = -1). Different from Unset.

states.name: Reading_Completed
states.description: Guillaume asserts the wave is finished. Asserted, never inferred.

states.name: Published
states.description: Owner: jgt-analysis-intelligence :8085. PublishCount wrote one AnalysisArtifact (artifact_type wave_count). Agents read it through jgt-analysis-mcp. Publishing does not ask for a blueprint.
states.notes: A drawing is a mark and never enters decision-context. Publishing is the human act that makes the count evidence. AO marks (ao_divergence, ao_divergence_watch, ao_no_divergence) are read here as momentum corroboration: W3 should carry the highest AO peak of the impulse and W5 a lower one (caishen spec 86; rispecs/consensus-trade-decision.spec.md; jgt-data-server/rispecs/wave-analysis.spec.md). Corroboration changes confidence, never the verdict (spec 85).

states.name: Published_Evaluating
states.description: The engine runs spec 85's pipeline at the degree of this timeframe, then reads AO corroboration.

states.name: Published_Tradable
states.description: The next wave at this degree is tradable. Direction gives the side, never the permission (spec 85 rule 3).

states.name: Published_StandAside
states.description: W4, B, D, Unknown or Unset at this degree. Standing aside is an active posture: prepare the next entry.

states.name: BlueprintRequested
states.description: Owner: jgt-analysis-intelligence :8085. Guillaume asked for a blueprint from this count; the agent drafts a TradeSetup that cites it (for W1-W2 labelled: look for the W3 entry).

states.name: Mandate
states.description: Owner: jgt-blueprint-api :8086. Guillaume authorizes once and chooses the mandate's invalidation, defaulting to the count's level. The mandate then watches for a breakout point.
states.notes: PROTOTYPE. Guillaume 2026-09-24: never delivered anything working; changes that complete it are welcome. 0 campaign_mandates, 0 mandate_delegations that day. Watching maps to the prototype's ARMED, Delegating to TRIGGERED. The prototype's own campaigns table carries a target amount and a desire statement: those belong to a project, not to a trading campaign, and are left out of this chain (G7, G9, G10; action A10).

states.name: Mandate_Watching
states.description: Authorized. The mandate holds a copy of the count as it was, and its invalidation level. It looks for the fractal whose break would start the next wave.

states.name: Mandate_Delegating
states.description: A breakout point is known. The blueprint creates one BOS strategy at that price in jgt-strategy-api, exactly once (MandateDelegation).

states.name: StrategicEntry
states.description: Owner: jgt-strategy-api :8083. The BOS strategy (fdb_breakout) runs its own machine: waits for the breakout, then for the FDB signal, then enters. BOSf (bosf_breakout) adds a fractal count before the signal once implemented. The strategy keeps the count as its reason through AnalysisStrategyLink.
states.notes: The entry machine's own states are not modelled here: fdb_breakout_strategy.smdf.json in jgt-strategy-api/smdf, and bosf_breakout_strategy.smdf.json in session 99a7ca1d.

states.name: Invalidated
states.description: Price reached the invalidation level. Transient: swap primary and alternate, cancel the setup, the mandate and any strategy not yet filled, each by name, then return to Reading with the former alternate as primary.

states.name: Expired
states.description: The mandate's valid_until passed with no breakout point. The count itself stays live.

states.name: Closed
states.description: The strategic entry ended. Its result is recorded on its trading campaign in jgt-strategy-api (total_wins, total_losses), which a trade review reads.
